voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: What have you done — you have slaughtered the Sun's own herds while I slept! O father Zeus, you lulled me to my ruin. This is doom, and no offering on earth will unmake it.
On the seventh day the wind falls and the ship leaves Thrinacia.
Zeus gathers a black cloud and strikes the mast with lightning.
The ship shatters and every crewman drowns.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Odysseus lashes keel and mast together.
Driven back to Charybdis, he hangs from the fig tree until the timbers reemerge, then drifts alone to Calypso.

keys.beat: Odysseus wakes, smells the meat, and condemns the act, but the crew feasts for six days.
On the seventh day the wind falls and the ship leaves Thrinacia.
Zeus gathers a black cloud and strikes the mast with lightning.
The ship shatters and every crewman drowns; Odysseus lashes keel and mast together.
Driven back to Charybdis, he hangs from the fig tree until the timbers reemerge, then drifts alone to Calypso.
